svg.title: Server-side classification: one sensing layer
svg.text: Restore RTC schedule, daily state and queue
Wake from RTC or pending retry
Check current time and unsent state
Do not classify an invalid capture as healthy
10 s windows, 5 s stride + final tail
Energy variation is not an RPW decision
Subtract the frozen PCA training mean
No classifier runs on this sensing node
Retain profile ID and window order
First vector + delta / Rice codes + escapes
Keep the shortest encoding or raw fallback
No additional PCA precision is discarded
No RPW label is generated here
Drain retained records at least daily
Send heartbeat even with no valid capture
Use the configured channel / SF / BW
Apply the planned TX slot / backoff
Gateway relays; queued data survives failure
Queue pending: schedule immediate TX wake
Else sleep until next sample / retry
EXTERNAL ENDPOINT ONLY - gateway relay and server classification
Gateway: validate / buffer / forward over Wi-Fi or cellular; no RPW inference at the gateway.
Server: check profile/version, reassemble fragments, unpack deltas, dequantize PCA16 and apply inverse PCA.
Reshape to normalized 30 x 13 MFCCs (do not normalize twice); classify windows, take maximum score, apply saved threshold, store / alert.
ONE piezo sensor + ONE ESP32-WROOM32 + ONE RFM95W link. Temporal windows are not extra sensing layers.
Current evaluated classifier route: four windows for a 20.5 s recording. Five-window delta packing is a payload experiment, not a revalidated classifier.
64 B refers to a feature-block target. Node/time identifiers, fragment headers, integrity/security and radio framing consume additional bytes.
Daily reporting remains required even after rejected captures. The energy-variation proxy is a quality statistic, not proof of RPW activity.
